releaseNotes: Adds Restore Recovery Snapshot under Plan > Import. A private GymTrackerRecoveryV1 snapshot restores the plan, workout logs, group data, rest-day data, stretch data, and preferences together. Workout-data imports now detect the full date range in the workbook by default, including older Excel date formats. Also includes the Today shortcut, bodyweight set display, separate set-management controls, and native theme color pickers. Users coming from the lost old signing key must use the documented export, uninstall, reinstall, and snapshot restore migration.
